title: Dipole ghosts and spontaneous symmetry breaking in higher-order Chern-Simons theory
summary: In this work, we investigate the emergence of dipole ghost structures in gauge theories at both the classical and quantum levels. Traditionally, dipole ghosts are introduced through an auxiliary field $χ$ satisfying $\Box^2χ=0$, whose presence is reflected in the appearance of double poles in the propagator. We show that such dipole ghost sectors can instead be understood as a consequence of the multiplicity of solutions of the classical equations of motion.
